question: Should Gitcrawl permanently adopt schema version 12, the `sync-failures` CLI surface, and the redacted opt-in portable ledger as the supported failure-tracking contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and the earlier privacy defect is repaired, but introducing a durable data model and public CLI/export surface requires explicit ownership of its long-term compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the durable contract
options.body: Approve the schema, CLI, coverage fields, and privacy-preserving portable behavior as supported surfaces and merge after required checks complete.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep failure tracking internal and revise or remove the CLI or portable opt-in before committing to those interfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept the durable contract
recommendation.body: Approve the schema, CLI, coverage fields, and privacy-preserving portable behavior as supported surfaces and merge after required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-head privacy repair and are the clearest available owner of the resulting portable-store contract.
